title: Keep the target and actuator different from energy response
statement: Define pi_i R_ij=sqrt(pi_i q_ij pi_j q_ji). Every prescribed SYMMETRIC pulse keeps the virtual reversible reference stationary at pi,without fitting/implementing R. Including waiting terms gives D(P_Rpulse||P_Qpulse)<=B sum_(i<j)(sqrt(a_ij)-sqrt(a_ji))^2<=B sigma0/4. Thus sigma0>=4 kl(r||s)/B>=8(r-s)^2/B,with the KL direction retained. Constant pulses additionally have nonnegative reversible endpoint covariance;time-varying noncommuting protocols do not inherit it. Nonstationary equilibrium starts or asymmetric energy/source-clock gating are negative controls that invalidate the premise. N713 geometric ENERGY response is prior and a different actuator;global clock-only scaling gives zero endpoint mean response. No new general kinetic-response principle or hidden-model sharp minimum is claimed.

requires: Finite irreducible all-even stationary CTMC with reciprocal support;unknown state count,mixing and escape cap allowed.
Prescribed SYMMETRIC rate multipliers m_ij=m_ji in[0,M(t)] with repaired diagonals;B=integral M(t)dt>0,actual calibrated duration and independent stationary preparations.
Finite fixed-n data receiver observes two endpoint bits per fresh trial;within-pair dependence is retained. No one-record/reset-free transfer or uncharged repeated stopping.
